name: Santa Clara County Self-Help Center
description: Free help with court forms, workshops, and self-representation in Santa Clara County
fullDescription: The Santa Clara County Self-Help Center provides free assistance to people representing themselves in court matters.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free help with court processes and review of completed forms
- Online workshops (starting a divorce, parentage, financial disclosures, guardianship, limited conservatorship, eviction answers)
- Family law help (custody, visitation, child and spousal support)
- Restraining order and emergency custody help
- Landlord/tenant (eviction) help
- Guardianship, conservatorship, name and gender changes
- Referrals to local nonprofit legal services
howToGetIt:
1. Watch an online workshop or email the Self-Help Center from the court website
2. Call 408-882-2926 or use LiveChat (Mon, Tue, Thu, 8:30 AM-1:30 PM)
3. For emergencies (restraining orders, emergency custody or guardianship, evictions), go in person to the Restraining Order Help Center at 201 N. First Street, San Jose (Mon-Thu 8:30 AM-1:30 PM, Fri 8:30 AM-12 PM)
4. Staff cannot give legal advice and only help people without an attorney
address: 201 N. First Street, San Jose, CA 95113
keywords: self-help, court, Santa Clara, San Jose, forms, family law, divorce, custody, restraining order, small claims, eviction, free legal help
